Registers and defines the `version` CLI subcommand, which prints the current `goval-dictionary` application version and revision to stdout.

## Key Components

| Component | Description |
|---|---|
| `versionCmd` | Cobra command registered under `version` that prints `config.Version` and `config.Revision` |
| `init()` | Registers `versionCmd` with the root command at package initialization |

## Usage Example

```bash
# Run the version subcommand
goval-dictionary version

# Example output
goval-dictionary v0.3.0 abc1234
```

```go
// Version and Revision values are sourced from config package
// config.Version  = "v0.3.0"
// config.Revision = "abc1234"
```

## Notes

- Version metadata (`config.Version`, `config.Revision`) is defined in the `config` package and is typically injected at build time via `-ldflags`.
- This command is automatically registered via `init()`, so importing the `commands` package is sufficient to make it available.

**Source:** [`commands/version.go`](https://github.com/flamingo-stack/fleetmdm/blob/main/commands/version.go)
